conditions.requires: Recruits1.15.2 client; captured crash in WATUT1.20.1-1.2.3; player acceptance pending

change.summary: Restore the missing native label-scale pose frame in exact Recruits1.15.2; fixes observed WATUT capture crash while preserving labels and caller transforms.

modifiers.before: DebugInvScreen.m_280003_(GuiGraphics,II)V unconditionally calls PoseStack.popPose at bytecode2044 despite no push in the method/class; ScreenBase labels is noop. This removes AbstractContainerScreen caller frame. WATUT renders the same screen for capture and then innerBlit/last fails with NoSuchElementException.
modifiers.after: Client-only, exact-version gated injection opens the missing local pose immediately before the native0.7 label scale. The existing native trailing pop closes it; AbstractContainerScreen caller frame and subsequent foreground/carried-item transforms remain intact. Native labels, inventory, commands, ordinary recruit and WATUT/FancyMenu behavior are retained.

cause.owner: Recruits1.15.2 DebugInvScreen native labels renderer via optional JEMCompat adapter

rationale.purpose: Repair the missing local matrix scope, preserving the native0.7 labels scale and trailing pop, rather than catch an empty stack, remove an intentional scale restoration, or disable WATUT/FancyMenu.
rationale.decision_source: User reported actual crash. Exact21:46:09 report identifies DebugInvScreen, PoseStack.last and WATUT capture. Bytecode735 scales0.7 and2044 pops without push; caller owns its separate frame. Codex chose a narrow injection immediately before the native scale because no public event reaches this local label scope.

introduced.summary: Restore the missing native label-scale pose frame in exact Recruits1.15.2; fixes observed WATUT capture crash while preserving labels and caller transforms.

history.summary: Restore the missing native label-scale pose frame in exact Recruits1.15.2; fixes observed WATUT capture crash while preserving labels and caller transforms.

notes: Client presentation only; no new registry, packet or server authority. Crash observed; corrected artifact/player acceptance remains in testing.

Five Whys: empty PoseStack in WATUT -> prior labels render consumed caller frame -> native labels scale/pop lacks local push -> DebugInvScreen violated AbstractContainerScreen matrix scope -> restore missing native scope exactly before the scale, retaining all native drawing.
